attributes.context: Section 1.1 defines the Agreement's covered work as the manufacture, fabrication, assembling, handling, erection, installation, dismantling, conditioning, adjustment, alteration, repairing, and servicing of metal work and air handling systems.

extraction_text: All computerized equipment used in the performance of work described in Section 1.1 shall be operated by a journeyman member of Local No. 73.

attributes.context: This appears in Article XIII, General Conditions, among general operating rules such as no limitation on the amount of work and employer discretion over small task assignments.

extraction_text: Section 13.2. Tools, No Restrictions. There shall be no restriction of the use of machinery, tools or appliances.
